lifecycle_note: Harvey blog 'Guardrails AI Joins Harvey' (Harvey Team, Sep 9, 2026): 'Harvey today announced its acquisition of San Francisco-based Guardrails AI.' The Guardrails AI blog version is dated Sep 8, 2026 (metadata Sep 9): co-founders and team join Harvey's product and engineering org; Harvey's 4th acquisition of 2026. No statement on the future of the OSS library or Guardrails Hub; the repo README has no archive or maintenance notice.

CrowdStrike press release, Las Vegas, September 16, 2025: 'signed a definitive agreement to acquire Pangea' to deliver AI Detection and Response (AIDR). Falcon AIDR went GA 2025-12-15. CrowdStrike unveiled 'Falcon Guardian', its AIDR solution, on 2026-09-01. pangea.cloud/services/ai-guard/ 301-redirects to CrowdStrike's falcon-aidr page, which in turn 301-redirects to /platform/falcon-guardian-aidr/. So AI Guard's successor is CrowdStrike Falcon Guardian (AIDR). The Guardian release itself doesn't name Pangea; the link rests on the redirect chain. Closing date not found on a primary page.

updates.new: Pangea acquired by CrowdStrike (definitive agreement announced 2025-09-16)

lifecycle_note: Boomi blog 'Lunar.dev Acquisition Strengthens AI Governance for Boomi Customers' (Published Jul 27, 2026): 'Boomi has acquired Lunar.dev to provide an essential AI gateway'. lunar.dev banner: 'Boomi has officially completed its acquisition of Lunar.dev.' docs.lunar.dev/mcpx/ now 301-redirects to help.boomi.com AI Gateway docs, so MCPX is now Boomi AI Gateway.

SentinelOne press release, Mountain View, August 5, 2025: 'signed a definitive agreement to acquire Prompt Security' (cash + stock, expected to close in SentinelOne's fiscal Q3 2026). prompt.security is now titled 'Prompt Security | From SentinelOne', and SentinelOne sells it at sentinelone.com/platform/securing-ai-prompt/ ('Prompt Security | SentinelOne AI Security Platform'). Exact close date not found on a primary page.

updates.new: Acquired by SentinelOne (definitive agreement announced 2025-08-05; cash and stock)

lifecycle_note: Arcade.dev blog 'Smithery Is Now Part of Arcade.dev' (Alex Salazar, Aug 5, 2026): 'Arcade.dev has acquired Smithery'; co-founder Anirudh Kamath joins Arcade. smithery.ai/future: 'On October 31, 2026, we're shutting down Smithery's connection management services': run.tools and server.smithery.ai URLs, Smithery API, Connect, Toolbox, accounts and API keys; CLI and SDKs deprecated. The registry continues as a public non-proxied MCP registry powered by Arcade.dev. Paid charges since Aug 5 are refunded. The smithery.ai banner says 'MCP Proxy and managed identity shut down on October 31.'

updates.new: Acquired by Arcade.dev (2026-08-05); connection services, API and SDKs shut down 2026-10-31, registry continues as a public directory

lifecycle_note: Snyk press release 'Snyk Acquires Invariant Labs to Accelerate Agentic AI Security Innovation', BOSTON, June 24, 2025: Snyk 'today announced the acquisition of Invariant Labs'; it joins Snyk Labs and the AI Trust Platform. invariantlabs.ai still carries a banner linking to it. The invariantlabs-ai/invariant (Invariant Guardrails) README has no archive or deprecation notice; its docs now live under invariantlabs-ai.github.io/docs/mcp-scan/guardrails-reference/. explorer.invariantlabs.ai/docs/ 301s to the GitHub repo.

Agent Router blog 'Envoy AI Gateway is becoming Agent Router, an Agentic AI Foundation project' (Sep 9, 2026): 'On 10 September, Agent Router, previously Envoy AI Gateway, officially joins the Agentic AI Foundation' and leaves the CNCF Envoy sub-project to become standalone. The README says 'Same code, same maintainers, same release cadence and Apache 2.0 license'. CRDs, the aigw CLI, images and Go module are unchanged; the repo moved to theagentrouter/agent-router and the site to theagentrouter.ai (aigateway.envoyproxy.io 301s). Agent Router 1.2 has since been released. Suggested name: 'Agent Router (formerly Envoy AI Gateway)'.

Project site (microsoft.github.io/presidio now meta-refreshes to data-privacy-stack.github.io/presidio, then presidio.dataprivacystack.org): 'Presidio has transitioned to a community-owned project.' The transition page says it is now at github.com/data-privacy-stack/presidio, 'maintained by contributors and volunteers from the community', 'Microsoft supported this transition', and it 'is not owned or operated by a commercial entity'. No transition date is given, and raw GitHub READMEs for both orgs returned 404 from this sandbox. Lifecycle stays active; record the ownership move (suggest name 'Presidio' and URL https://presidio.dataprivacystack.org/). This is neither an acquisition nor a rename of the software.
